overall_goal: Add risotto rice and white wine to the pan and cook until the alcohol evaporates

goals.rationale: The person retrieves wine from the fridge, opens it, and pours it into a measuring jug to get the right amount before bringing it to the hob.

goals.description: Add the risotto rice to the pan
goals.rationale: The person makes space in the pan and tips the bowl of risotto rice into it.

goals.description: Stir and cook the rice and mushrooms
goals.rationale: The person continuously stirs the rice and mushrooms in the pan to cook them evenly and prevent burning.

goals.description: Pour the white wine into the pan
goals.rationale: The person pours the measured white wine from the jug into the pan and sets the empty jug aside.

goals.description: Stir the mixture to evaporate the alcohol
goals.rationale: The person stirs and shakes the pan to mix the ingredients and let the wine bubble and evaporate.
